updates.note: Polycarbonate integrated facility commissioning pushed to FY30
updates.quote: the polycarbonate integrated facility commissioning. ... the integrated asset from propylene to polycarbonate resin is in line with the feedstock availability plan. So you will see the polycarbonate resin certainly come in earlier.

updates.note: Polycarbonate commissioning timeline moved to FY30
updates.quote: The polycarbonate commissioning is pushed back to FY30, whereas earlier, I believe, the timeline was FY29.

updates.note: Total project capex revised to INR 11,700 crore
Assets including MIBK and MIBC commissioned
updates.quote: progressing with the commercialization as well as scale up for manufacturing downstream products such as MIBK, MIBC as well as the derivatives.

new_promises.statement: Total capex spend for next year (FY28) will be INR 2,200 crore to INR 2,400 crore.
new_promises.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

new_promises.statement: Total capex spend for FY 2028-2029 will be INR 2,500 crore.
new_promises.quote: INR 2,500 crore in the second year, that is FY 2028-2029
new_promises.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay
